about: What is replaced by ＊ in the training text (Training/cleaning.py, redact()) and in the input method's learning records (Engine/Redaction.swift): one list for both. Patterns are written to mean the same in Python's re and in ICU (NSRegularExpression). {{NAME}} is replaced by vars[NAME] before compiling; in replace, $1 is the first group. A rule with "generated": true replaces a match only when it looks generated (see its why). Running the rules twice must give what running them once gives (the learning store redacts its records anew at every start; Training/test_cleaning.py checks it). Rules apply in order: e-mail before "@someone", accounts before plain digits. Training/test_cleaning.py and Tools/symtest check them.

rules.why: Addresses whose "://" the corpus lost: httpwww.bilibili.com…, httpmp.weixin.qq.com…
Web addresses from wherever http:// or www. starts, no \b: Chinese characters count as word characters, so 网址http://… had none, and glued text (7http://…, increasewww.…) has none either.
Bare domains in small letters, as they are written (user.Info in code is not one).
Suffixes that are also file extensions or words (index.md, req.params.id): a domain only with a path or a query after it (now.to/x5c).
The account after 微信, QQ and the like, within one line ([ \t], never \s, which would reach into the next line).
Latin names only before 号 or a colon (wxWidgets is not an account).
…or before a space and an account with a digit ("go on QQ immediately" is not one).
The name after 姓名, 联系人, 收件人 (姓名学 is not a field).
The name after "@", up to 20 characters (a chat app puts a space after the name). Not "@＊" again: the store redacts its records anew at every start, so every rule must leave its own output as it is.
Building, unit and room of an address: 3号楼2单元401.
Unit and room: 第二单元104.

Letters and digits mixed, 20 or more, with many digits (link parameters, keys, check codes, file names); replaced only when a quarter of the run is digits, or it is 40 or more long with a tenth digits, so names with a digit or two stay (CanvasRenderingContext2D).
A bank card number written in groups of four.
Six or more digits in a row (phone, ID card with its final X, bank card, codes). Dates and times such as 2016-07-20 11:30, or numbers merely next to each other, are not one run.
